definitions.full: H8561. timorah תִּמֹרָה 19 noun feminine palm(-tree), figure , as ornament; — ׳ת Ezek 41:18 + (van d. H. ׳תִּמּ , so throughout); plural תִּמֹרֹת 1Kin 6:29 + (Gi ׳תִּמּ ), תִּמֹרִים Ezek 40:16 +; suffix תִּימֹרָיו 40:22 Qr (Kt תימרו ); — palm-figure in Solomon's temple 1Kin 6:29 , 32 (twice in verse); 6:35 ; 7:36 ; 2Chr 3:5 ; in Ezekiel's temple Ezek 40:16 , 22 , 26 10 t. 40, 41.

occurrences.englishText: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.
So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

On the plates of its supports, and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.
He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
There were closed windows to the lodges, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.
